what_this_is: Measured facts about the demo film, which is not in this repository. The file is held outside it and no public link is published here until there is one to publish. The numbers are what ffprobe and ffmpeg's loudness meter read off the finished file, written by the script that produced it. That script is outside this repository too, for the same reason the film is, so this file is the whole of what a reader here can check: the hash below identifies the exact file the numbers were taken from.
why_it_is_here: Three surfaces carried a running time typed by hand and a re-render moved the cut by five seconds, so all three were wrong at once.
narration_note: The greeting is a recording of the author. Every other line is a voice clone of the same speaker, rendered one sentence at a time and joined on a fixed gap. The call heard in act two is the parent's own voice, from the recording CALL-E returned.
